description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wakka
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Aurochs Reels (0~2), removed after using Apex Aurochs Reels two times

description.name: Apex Aurochs Reels Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Aurochs Reels level by 1 after using 7 Sharpshooter or Support abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wakka]

description.name: Apex Aurochs Reels Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Aurochs Reels level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Wakka]
